trigger.title: The Capex Pause
trigger.body: Two of the largest AI buyers cut next year's data-centre spending and walk away from queued sites. Speculative requests start withdrawing by the hundred.

decoy.name: The record auction
decoy.reason: A capacity auction clears at the cap with a record uncapped price, after a run of old plant retirements. It looks like the squeeze of Queue is King; it is a one-off on the supply side.
decoy.tell: The Capacity Market spikes while AI Demand slides and the Grid Queue starts to shorten. A real squeeze needs new load; this auction was driven by plants retiring, and the next one clears lower.
